svg.text: Holes and recesses, from datum A
14 square through, first of 12 on a 19.05 grid
lens recess 39.2 x 14.8, R2.1, 1.15 deep from above
opening 37 x 14.8 through, in its middle
GAP AND LAP JOINT, front wall, 8:1
Scale 1.5:1 plans, 2:1 section, 8:1 detail, on A3. Dimensions in mm, computed from the model.
Datum A: back-left corner of the box round the outline, seen from above. X to the right, Y toward the front.
3-axis, two setups: underside up, then top side up.
Every pocket corner is R1.5 or larger; the switch cut-outs have corner reliefs of that radius.
Switch cut-outs 14 square in a 1.5 mm plate. Take their tolerance from the Cherry MX datasheet.
Key dish: flat floor on the plate, walls at 45 degrees, 3.5 deep. A 90 degree chamfer mill cuts the walls.
Pilot holes are for self-tapping M2 in plastic. In aluminium drill 1.6 and tap M2.
Outline corners: one quintic Bezier each, control points 10, 6 and 2 mm from the box corner on both sides. Take the curve from the STEP file.
General tolerance: ISO 2768-m is a proposal. Nothing has been made or measured.
